strings.name: Wang Xing
strings.summary: Wang moved from campus social networking and microblogging to local commerce through Xiaonei, Fanfou and Meituan. After merging with Dianping and listing in Hong Kong, Meituan connected dining, delivery and instant retail, while facing labor, competition and compliance issues. It was fined for exclusivity in 2021 and continued adjusting efficiency amid intense competition in 2026. Wang holds degrees from Tsinghua and Delaware.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounded Meituan and developed local-services and instant-delivery platforms, changing dining consumption and urban-service organization.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Electronic-engineering bachelor’s, Tsinghua (2001); electrical-engineering master’s, University of Delaware (2005).
strings.highlights.h1.title: From social networks to local services
strings.highlights.h1.text: Moved from Xiaonei and Fanfou toward local transactions connecting merchants and consumers.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Meituan’s expansion
strings.highlights.h2.text: Combined Dianping and delivery networks to develop dining, in-store services and instant retail.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Reported interim business adjustments
strings.timeline.t1.text: His chairman’s statement discussed competition, service efficiency and platform operations.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Company accepted antitrust penalty
strings.timeline.t2.text: Regulators fined Meituan RMB 3.442 billion for restricting merchant choice; it committed to rectification.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Meituan Dianping listed
strings.timeline.t3.text: Listed on Hong Kong’s Main Board, with Wang responsible for strategy and management.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Meituan and Dianping combined
strings.timeline.t4.text: The local-services businesses merged strategically, reorganizing operations and ownership.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Founded meituan.com
strings.timeline.t5.text: Established a group-buying platform that expanded into delivery and other local services.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Cofounded Fanfou
strings.timeline.t6.text: Helped establish the microblogging website and managed its early operations.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Cofounded Xiaonei
strings.timeline.t7.text: Built a university social network with partners; the business later became Renren.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completed Tsinghua studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned his electronic-engineering degree before further electrical-engineering studies in the United States.
